offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Go online to see jobs from farms in your service area.

empty.availableHint: New jobs appear here the moment a farmer releases an order in your area. This list refreshes by itself.
empty.activeHint: Accept a job from the Available tab to start.
empty.historyHint: Delivered and cancelled jobs show up here.

detail.notFound: This job is no longer available.
detail.areaOnly: Full address and phone numbers are shown after you accept.
detail.farmerNotConfirmed: Waiting for the farmer to confirm the handover

actions.releaseBody: It goes straight back to the pool for other couriers. Only do this before you collect the animal.

next.acceptedHint: Check the animal against the ear tag, then take your pickup photo.
next.picked_upHint: Take a photo as you set off. The buyer is told you are on the way.
next.in_transitHint: Ask the buyer for their 6-digit code, then take the two handover photos.

problem.title: Report a problem
problem.subtitle: The buyer, the farmer and QURBI are told straight away.
problem.reasonHint: Be specific so QURBI can decide the next step.

pickupFlow.title: Collect the livestock
pickupFlow.earTag: The ear tag matches the order
pickupFlow.secured: The animal is safely secured in my vehicle
pickupFlow.blocked: Do not collect the animal until all three are true. Report a problem instead.

deliverFlow.title: Hand over to the buyer
deliverFlow.codeHint: The buyer finds it on their order page while you are on the way.
